culprit_citations.quoted_text: Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars (USD) unless otherwise noted, Euro, Great British Pound, or Canadian dollar (CAD).
Investments-non-controlled/non-affiliated | Par Amount/Shares (4) | Cost (5) | Fair Value

rationale: The two FX03 cells store U_CAD as cost_currency. The raw schedule separates Par Amount/Shares (footnote 4) from Cost (footnote 5), and footnote 4 explicitly limits CAD denomination to par amount. Carrying the par-amount XBRL unit into cost_currency is therefore a localized currency-field classification error; the cost values belong to the USD-denominated valuation columns.
